title: Columns - The Diva Of The Bathroom!
bodyHtml:
If you’re looking to make a statement in your bathroom there’s no better way than to incorporate a column. These divas of the bathroom are tall and gorgeous!

When shopping for a column make sure to use a good quality product, their size makes them difficult to produce and poor-quality workmanship really shows up on these large pieces. Another consideration is storage, because columns don’t have any shelving or drawers like a vanity, be sure to consider placing some discreet storage compartments elsewhere in the bathroom. 

Tapware

When pairing tapware you have a heap of options:
1. Ceiling
2. Floor
3. Basin Mounted - our Ovvio and Semplice Columns have versions with built-in Tap Landing
4. Wall-Mounted 

Installation

Our columns are typically supplied as p-trap, which means the column has a cut-out in the rear allowing for tapware and pipes to travel through the wall. We can also supply (made to order) s-trap versions of all our columns, which allows you to install them away from the wall for a truly interesting aesthetic!

Colour

To really make your column pop, consider a splash of colour. Matte black, aqua or cement will make your bathroom truly memorable!
